summary: 「我、你、他」和「我的、你的、他的」——人称代词做主语/宾语，物主代词表示所属关系。

rules.title: 人称代词：主格 vs 宾格
rules.detail: 主格（I, you, he, she, it, we, they）作主语；宾格（me, you, him, her, it, us, them）作动词或介词的宾语。

rules.title: 形容词性物主代词：my / your / his / her / its / our / their
rules.detail: 后面必须跟名词，表示「谁的」：my book（我的书）、his bag（他的包）。

rules.title: 名词性物主代词：mine / yours / his / hers / ours / theirs
rules.detail: 单独使用，后面不跟名词 = 形容词性物主代词 + 名词。my book = mine；her bag = hers。

examples.en: This is my pen. That is yours.
examples.zh: 这是我的钢笔。那是你的（钢笔）。
那辆红色自行车是他的。

pitfalls: 介词后误用主格：❌ between you and I → ✓ between you and him（介词后用宾格）
her / hers 混用：❌ This is her book = This is hers book. → ✓ This is hers.（hers 后不能加名词）
it's 和 its 混淆：it's = it is；its 是「它的」

questions.stem: ___ am a new student in Class 3.
Miss Gao teaches ___ English. We all like her classes.
questions.explain: teach 是动词，后面用宾格 us（我们）。
schoolbag 是名词，前面用形容词性 your；第二空后面没有名词，用名词性 his。

questions.stem: The cat is cute. ___ name is Mimi.
questions.explain: its 表示「它的」；it's = it is，意思是「它是」，此处不通。

questions.stem: These books are ___ (they). They bought them yesterday.
questions.explain: 后面没有名词，用名词性物主代词 theirs = their books。
后面有名词 English teacher，用形容词性物主代词 our。

questions.stem: Can you help ___ (I) with my math?
questions.explain: help 是动词，后接宾格 me。

questions.stem: Her and me are in the same class.
questions.answer: Her and me → She and I
questions.explain: 作主语要用主格：she 和 I。

questions.stem: 这个书包是我的，那个是他的。（翻译整句）
answer: this schoolbag is mine and that one is his.
this schoolbag is mine, and that one is his.
questions.explain: mine = my schoolbag；his 既可作形容词性也可作名词性。

questions.stem: 他经常帮助我们学英语。（翻译整句）
answer: he often helps us with our english.
he often helps us learn english.
he often helps us to learn english.
questions.explain: help sb with sth / help sb (to) do sth；us 是宾格。
